Picks the bus that the channels of a sound start on, the way [SoundVolume](SoundVolume) picks their volume. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
SoundBus footsteps, world
PlaySound footsteps ; plays on the world bus
```
@param sound  A sound from [LoadSound](LoadSound) or [Load3DSound](Load3DSound). `0` is ignored.
@param bus  A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error.
